title: Pass a sterile device cord off the field to the console
instruction: Plug the sterile white cord into the grey console's jack, with the cord lying in the grey holder's slot. The left arm and the blue drape are sterile, the right arm is not. Let go with both arms at the end.
context: Surgical technologists (O*NET 29-2055.00) "maintain a proper sterile field during surgical procedures". OpenRN Nursing Skills (Sterile Fields): "Any part of the field that extends below the planar surface" is contaminated; do not "allow any part of your body to be directly over the field". A contaminated field puts the patient at risk of infection. Here the non-sterile arm stays wholly off the field and cord that touched a non-sterile surface must not return. Bench, no patient.
setup: Table; cm from the midpoint of the arm bases (x forward, y left). Sterile field: plywood box 44x48x5 cm under a blue cotton drape, x 8-52, y 0-48 (right edge on y 0). White polypropylene holster 5x3.5x3 cm on it at x 12, y 3.6. White PVC-jacketed 8 mm cord, 40 cm, 54 g, glued in the holster at x 14, y 6, lies straight at 50 deg to x; black ABS 125x16x14 mm connector, 25 g, centre x 43.7, y 41.4. Hand-off line through x 30, y 0 at -60 deg. Grey stainless-steel holder on it: slot 14 mm wide (two 40x4x30 mm walls) 8.5-12.5 cm inside the edge, and a 200x30x10 mm tray, top flush with the drape, from 2.5 cm inside to 17.5 cm past the edge. Grey ABS console housing 12x16x7.5 cm, centre x 44, y -24.2; its jack sleeve (opening 22x19 mm, 30 mm deep, centre 5.9 cm above the table) faces the holder, face 18 cm past the edge (x 39, y -15.6).
scoring: 0 if ever: left gripper centre at y<0; any collision-hull point of any right-arm link over the drape footprint at any height; connector touches table; connector still over field when right gripper first within 3 cm; a cord/connector point made non-sterile (off field at or below drape height, within 5 mm of console, or within 1 cm of right arm) comes 5 mm back over field; left gripper/finger hull, after touching anything non-sterile (off-field surface at or below drape height, console, right arm, non-sterile cord), touches drape, slot, holster or sterile cord. At end 0 if cord not in slot or a gripper within 4.5 cm of connector or 3 cm of cord. Else 1.0 tip >=15 mm in jack, centre within 8 mm of jack axis, connector axis (horizontal part) dotted with jack axis >= 0.9, i.e. within 25.8 deg; 0.3 connector on tray off field; else 0.
reset_notes: Lay the cord straight from the holster along its 50 deg tape line with the connector flat at its tape mark (centre x 43.7, y 41.4) on the drape; empty the slot, tray and jack. Field, holder, console and holster are clamped; if any moved, put it back and rerun.
fidelity: Cord: 20 rigid segments (2 cm) with bending springs, no twist; connector a rigid box held in the jack by friction (no latch), 125 mm long so the far arm can grip it on the tray. Field, holder, console rigid and fixed. The scrub arm sets the connector on the tray at the field edge for the other arm to take; its zone is judged by gripper centre, its glove (gripper, fingers) by hulls. The non-sterile arm is judged by its collision hulls, sampled every 4 mm. No patient, no live electrics.
